title: Cislunar Orbital Network: code and data for "Orbital Networks in the Three-Body Problem"
description:
MATLAB code and numerical results accompanying the paper Orbital Networks in the Three-Body Problem by A. Braik and S. D. Ross, Advances in Space Research (2026), doi:10.1016/j.asr.2026.10.100.

The code builds forward and backward reachable-set atlases for thirteen periodic orbit families at a common Jacobi constant in the planar Earth-Moon CR3BP, infers pairwise family accessibility from reachable-set overlap, and assembles the results into a weighted cislunar orbital network. Included numerical results: the family-to-family ΔV and time-of-flight proxy matrices, budget-plane network diagnostics (node centrality metrics and per-budget snapshot summaries), and differential-correction summaries of the corrected trajectory realizations. The full reachable-set atlases (hundreds of GB) are not archived; the code regenerates them deterministically.

Interactive ΔV-map visualization: binbraik.github.io/cislunar_orbital_network.
